name: jedinstveni matični broj (matični broj)
issuer: the Ministry of Internal Affairs (MUP), in the Central Population Register
note: Paragraf.me (4 December 2019, trade press reprinting the Ministry of Internal Affairs' statement to RTCG of 29 November 2019; the Law on the Central Population Register itself, Sl. list RCG 49/07 as amended by Sl. list CG 41/10, 55/16 and 77/24, as the 2026 amending law cites it; the 40/2011 named here until 2026-11-03 isn't among them, wasn't found in its official text today): under that Law the matični broj has 13 digits in six groups: the day, month and year of birth, the register number, a combination of digits marking sex and serial number, and a control number; it is determined ex officio by the child's place of birth, the person's residence when it is determined, or the place of entry in the register of births where the person has no residence in Montenegro; a child of Montenegrin citizens born abroad is given one on entry in the register of births; a person may hold only one. Read as given at birth (entry in the register of births), to citizens and residents. The pattern holds day (01 to 31) and month (01 to 12) and nine more digits; the year's three digits, the register areas (the Rulebook, Sl. list CG 15/2008, not read) and the control digit's rule aren't held. No fee or time is stated, nor what needs it. The Law amending it (adopted 31 July 2026, promulgated 3 August 2026, in force on the eighth day after its publication in the Službeni list, whose issue date wasn't read), read 2026-11-03 on the Službeni list's own site, adds a foreigner's approved permanent or temporary residence to art. 24(1)'s places that determine the number; art. 24's six groups weren't read on a primary, so the entry stays secondary.

sources.title: Paragraf.me, ZAKON O CENTRALNOM REGISTRU STANOVNIŠTVA: Za svaki zahtjev za promjenu matičnog broja vodi se upravni postupak (4 December 2019)
sources.said: propisano da se matični broj sastoji od 13 cifara, svrstanih u šest grupa. ... Te grupe čine dan, mjesec i godina rođenja, broj registra, kombinacija cifara kojima se označava pol i redni broj, i kontrolni broj. ... matični broj određuje po službenoj dužnosti, prema mjestu rođenja djeteta, prebivalištu osoba u trenutku određivanja matičnog broja ... U postupku upisa u matični registar rođenih, djetetu se shodno zakonu određuje matični broj ... osoba može imati samo jedan matični broj sa kojim se služi.

sources.title: Službeni list Crne Gore, no. 2153: Ukaz o proglašenju Zakona o dopunama Zakona o centralnom registru stanovništva (adopted 31 July 2026, promulgated 3 August 2026)
sources.said: U Zakonu o centralnom registru stanovništva („Službeni list RCG”, broj 49/07 i „Službeni list CG”, br. 41/10, 55/16 i 77/24) ...
